topic: Mertens (2024), Section 5, page 19, after equation (22): grid–cylinder domination growth equality
title: Boundary bounds for Mertens's grid–cylinder conjecture: an alternative proof and extensions

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We give a finite-boundary alternative proof of Mertens's grid–cylinder growth equality (2024, Section 5, page 19, after equation (22)), which already follows from Gangloff and Talon's grid results (2019/2020). The per-vertex counts have the same unrestricted joint limit as both side lengths tend to infinity. An injective boundary repair gives g(m,n) <= c(m,n) <= 4^n g(m,n). Block arguments yield explicit rectangle and strip bounds, and the comparison extends to every positive activity and to king graphs with periodic boundaries.
summary: An explicit same-size seam inequality and complete proofs of rectangle enclosures, strip estimates and positive-activity boundary independence, with earlier grid and torus results credited.
